summary: Join our Water Demand Forecasting and Management Training Course to master essential techniques for optimizing water resources and ensuring sustainability.
lede: Water demand forecasting combines consumption data, demand drivers and planning models to estimate future water needs. This course is for utility managers, planners and other water-resource professionals who make allocation decisions; it covers interpreting usage data, comparing demand scenarios, weighing trade-offs across sectors and communicating decisions to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who regularly balance supply, demand, and strategic water resource decisions, including:
modules: Risk and Resilience in Water Planning
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
